description: Standalone mod that removes most hardcoded caps for ServerGameSettings.json values
readme:
## Installation
Extract `version.dll` into dedicated server folder (`V Rising\VRising_Server` if you play with friends using in-game hosting button).

## What does this mod do?
It removes most of the limits from `ServerGameSettings.json` values, so you can use any value you want for drop rates (`DropTableModifier_General`), stack size, etc.
Note: as of 1.1 October Patch most of the config values are capped at 100 by default without any mods. 

# Notes: 
While you can set stack sizes multiplier to any value, on clients stack size will not be displayed higher than 4096 (although real item amount will be higher)

Untested on Linux.

Untested in singleplayer.

Have no idea if it works properly with mod manager.
